stage: proposed-circuit review; final saved CAD not yet handed off
scope: Four standard Qwiic connectors: J9 to separately powered SparkFun WRL-15663 master, other three to locally powered sensor expansion. Read-only; no CAD mutations.

initial_orientation_finding.description: Local MPR sensor on buffer B side lacks guaranteed logic-low compatibility.
initial_orientation_finding.resolution: Put local sensor bus on A and specified ESP32 master on B. Root and owner notified.

required_passives: 100 nF local VCCA bypass and 100 nF host VCCB bypass close to physical pins
One 4.7 kohm pullup per host signal to HOST_3V3; existing local R15/R20 pullups remain
Optional 10 kohm HOST_3V3-to-GND discharge resistor is compatible; adds 0.33 mA nominal host load

logic_checks.local_MPR_to_buffer_A: 0.2*local VDD maximum sensor low < 0.3*local VCCA buffer input threshold
logic_checks.buffer_A_to_local: 0.2 V maximum at 6 mA; acceptable to local PCA9685/TCA9534A inputs
logic_checks.ESP32_to_buffer_B: ESP32 published VOL maximum 0.1*VDD = 0.33 V nominal < 0.45 V input contention limit
logic_checks.buffer_B_to_ESP32: 0.60 V maximum < ESP32 VIL maximum 0.25*VDD = 0.825 V nominal
logic_checks.ESP32_current_caveat: Do not describe 28 mA as guaranteed at VOL 0.33 V: the separate 28 mA typical sink-current line is tested at 0.495 V. Keep modest pullup loading.
logic_checks.unrelated_local_startup: U5 sensor reset/ramp finding remains open; this interface does not repair it

power_states.expected: No powered interface; disconnected supplies remain separate
VCCB powered, VCCA zero: buffer outputs high impedance; host cannot drive local unpowered bus through buffer
VCCB and EN zero: buffer outputs high impedance; local bus stays powered independently and no watchdog change resets outputs
Bidirectional I2C operation with two independently powered pullup domains and common ground

power_state_limit: These are datasheet-backed circuit expectations, not measured leakage, hot-plug, brownout or transient results. Power-up driver thresholds are not a guarantee of valid communication during rail ramps.

external_multiplexer.supported_plan: TCA9548A with only one RheoBoard channel enabled at a time
external_multiplexer.reason: Simultaneous branches connect B-side buffers together, which TI prohibits, and duplicate sensor addresses also collide
external_multiplexer.required: No upstream B-side repeater or rise-time accelerator. Total selected host-segment pullup current should stay within 3 mA and preserve rise-time limits. Selected branch effective pullup resistance must be at least 2.2 kohm including module resistors and tolerances, at host 3.0-3.6 V.
external_multiplexer.pass_switch_check: TCA9548A RON maximum 30 ohm at 3.0-3.6 V; branch 4.7 kohm contributes about 21 mV worst conservative drop at 3.3 V. Its own 0.4 V/3 mA ACK plus branch drop remains below 0.45 V.
external_multiplexer.branch_pullup_derivation: At VDD=3.6 V, allow less than 0.05 V added drop beyond the mux's 0.40 V ACK: R_branch > (3.6-0.4)*30/0.05 = 1920 ohm. Require at least 2200 ohm effective including resistor tolerances for margin; at that lower bound, drop <=43.64 mV and low <=0.44364 V. Total pullup current <=3 mA alone does not establish this branch-specific bound. Existing 4.7 kohm board pullups meet it; extra module resistors must be combined in parallel before acceptance.
external_multiplexer.caveat: Unknown mux module pullups, cable capacitance and other upstream modules require system-level checking. No blanket arbitrary-Qwiic-chain compatibility claim.
